# secureaccess_dlp_ai_guardrails_data_identifiers (Data Source)

This resource reads DLP AI Guardrails Data Identifiers.
 If `items` is empty, all DLP AI Guardrails Data Identifiers are returned, otherwise only the listed ones.
 If `filter` is provided, only DLP AI Guardrails Data Identifiers matching the filter are returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "secureaccess_dlp_ai_guardrails_data_identifiers" "example" {
  items = {
    "Email Address" = {
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) Case-insensitive substring used to filter DLP AI Guardrails data identifiers by name.
- `items` (Attributes Map) Map of DLP AI Guardrails Data Identifiers. The key of the map is the name of the individual DLP AI Guardrails Data Identifier. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Id of the DLP AI Guardrails Data Identifier.
